adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the recurring-event delete path is executed inside `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` (new loop after changing `.find` to `.filter`). But that branch ignores the current `reference`/`credentialId` and instead iterates `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(..._calendar)` and for each `updBooking` uses `updBooking.references.find(ref => ref.type.includes('_calendar'))`, i.e. only the first calendar reference per booking. This means (a) the same main/first calendar event can be deleted repeatedly once per original reference, and (b) additional calendar references for other hosts/credentials in the recurring series are not targeted (only the first `_calendar` ref is used), so multi-host recurring events can be left undeleted.
